guide_zh.overview: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.

readme.markdown: > **84% of students already use AI tools. Only 18% feel prepared to use them > professionally.** This curriculum closes that gap. > > 503 lessons. 20 phases. ~320 hours. Python, TypeScript, Rust, Julia. Every lesson ships > a reusable artifact: a prompt, a skill, an agent, an MCP server. Free, open source, MIT. > > You don't just learn AI. You build it. End-to-end. By hand.
